description.value: Bernie's is a supper club and cinema experience on Kelowna's main downtown strip, pairing a full-service restaurant with an in-house movie theatre. The menu leans heavily on Okanagan-region ingredients and a dedicated raw bar featuring oysters, seafood towers, and caviar. Touring cyclists looking for an upscale downtown Kelowna dinner stop will find local craft beers, creative cocktails, and a distinctive dine-in-film atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bernie's is a Supper Club & Cinema at 353 Bernard Ave, Kelowna, corroborating the OSM address and providing a phone number absent from OSM. The FAQ page explicitly states the menu includes 'gluten free, vegetarian, and vegan options,' confirming that amenity. No evidence on the website addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or charging, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM name 'Bernies' is missing the apostrophe; website consistently uses 'Bernie's'.
Phone number 778-484-9836 sourced from website contact page; field is empty in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Bernie's is an active, full-service restaurant in downtown Kelowna with confirmed vegetarian/vegan/GF options; a legitimate and useful listing for touring cyclists seeking an upscale dinner stop on the main commercial corridor.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ page states: 'Our menu has a variety of gluten free, vegetarian, and vegan options and our kitchen team does the best they can to accommodate to any dietary restrictions or allergies.'
